answer: Because your car is paid off, you'll need to get a duplicate title from California before Northwind can complete the purchase, but you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait. Start by getting an instant offer online with your VIN or license plate (stores no longer give walk-in quotes), then book an appraisal at a store or, in most states, at your home. A specialist inspects the car in about 30 minutes and confirms the offer, and then you sign the paperwork and get paid. The help center doesn't say how to request a California duplicate title or how long it takes, so please contact a store for those details.
